intro.title: Collaborate with MARVI
intro.lede: MARVI works with communities, governments, NGOs, researchers and educators interested in practical approaches to groundwater stewardship.

items.title: Use the MARVI approach
items.text: MARVI brings technical knowledge, community experience and practical monitoring together at village level.

photo.alt: Farmers and a Bhujal Jankaar in the field

items.title: Research collaboration
items.text: The project works across hydrology, hydrogeology, agronomy, economics and social science. The result is not a report left on a shelf, but knowledge a community can use.

items.title: Training & capacity building
items.text: These trained volunteers measure wells, rainfall, water quality and check dams. They interpret local patterns, explain them in the community’s own language and help farmers see that groundwater is both limited and shared.
